description: Why revenue moved for one website: the window against the same-length prior window, split into new and renewal revenue, the channels, landing pages, search queries and referrer hosts (any site, not only AI) that moved it (the top 5 per group; search_query is estimated from Search Console), and which sources over-index among new payers. Same from/to/time_zone/currency as analytics_snapshot. Quote summary and the movers; do not recompute them.

from.description: inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD; default last 60 days

period.description: named window instead of from/to: today, yesterday, 7d, 28d, 30d, 90d, 365d (each ends today), this_month, or last_month

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

name: revenue_moves
title: Why revenue moved
